d: The 2026 US Midterms put anti-India rhetoric and defence ties with India in focus. Attacks on Indian immigrants, H-1B workers and South Asian communities reportedly fuelled discontent among Indian-American voters, raising questions about the impact on Republican support. Meanwhile, the Philippines has praised India's BrahMos missile system after testing its capabilities during the MASA 2026 military drills.
